climate: Most rain falls in winter. Dry summers keep mildew and rot down, though young vines may need watering.
land: Slopes face several ways, so growers can pick warmer or cooler spots to suit each grape.

blurb.text: A tiny Mendocino County AVA on a 500 acre ranch in a narrow mountain valley between Boonville and Highway 101. The valley is about a mile long and half a mile across, among hills 1,400 to 1,600 feet high.
